content: The dataset statistics can be found in Table TABREF7. The number of examples we collected increases per round, starting with approximately 19k examples for Round 1, to around 47k examples for Round 2, to over 103k examples for Round 3. We collected more data for later rounds not only because that data is likely to be more interesting, but also simply because the base model is better and so annotation took longer to collect good, verified correct examples of model vulnerabilities.
